attBesluta.text: This was great quality and looks so cute. Didn’t come with instructions but we were able to look them up. 3 year old loves it
Great little playhouse. Very solid wooden construction.

arrived on time, very heavy box so make arrangements to get it where you need to assemble it. it took 3-4 hours to put together instructions were clear and easy to follow! my daughter is super happy with it plays in there every day she is a tall 5 year old so be mindful of how many children and how tall they are when you buy this is would say good fo up to 5 years old

Estaba al principio preocupada por la entrega pero llego perfectamente y al tiempo estimado correcto. La casita es realmente preciosa, no tiene suelo así que la coloqué sobre césped artificial. Las instrucciones son impecables es cierto que se requiere cierta experiencia pero la montamos en 2horas y media más o menos entre 2 personas. Las piezas encajan perfectamente y la solidez de la madera nos pareció magnífica. Estamos muy satisfechos con la compra. Le pondré alguna plantita más y un gran lazo para que los niños la reciban de regalo el día de Reyes magos y espero que la disfruten muchos años! Gracias!
Wel 2 weken onderweg geweest. Maar goed op de hoogte gehouden van de levering. Ook wel een werkje om in elkaar te steken, maar wel een goed plan erbij. Heel mooi huisje, heel tevreden.
very cute colour started to peel after a couple of months easy to put together

It exceeded my expectations in both quality and functionality. The playhouse is made from wood, which feels very durable and well-built. It holds up great outdoors and gives me confidence that it will last through different weather conditions. Assembly took some time, but the end result was definitely worth it. Once set up, it looks beautiful in the garden and blends nicely with the outdoor space.
I love this playhouse, it was a fun surprise. It is sturdy and I feel like it is safe. Just a bit small for a two year old but she still enjoys it very much.

I bought this plastic puppet theater for my niece’s birthday, and she absolutely loves it. The cute design and bright colors caught her attention immediately, and she started playing with it right away. The plastic material is sturdy and resistant to drops and scratches. Assembly is quick and easy, no tools required, making it convenient for busy parents.

This plastic puppet theater is ideal for young children. It’s lightweight, so my son can easily move it around his playroom, and the durable plastic material is easy to clean with a damp cloth. The bright colors attract kids’ attention, and assembly is simple with snap-together parts. The theater has a large stage and easy-to-open curtains, providing hours of entertainment.

We bought this for our 2 year old grandson for his 2nd birthday. It can quickly and is well made. Price was much better than other places we looked at, so was a bit worried about quality. Now, we had to add some wood over the top because he was too quick to learn to climb up on the top, and his parents felt we was too young for that part of the climbing part. We'll take it off once he gets a little bigger and can handle the top railing. He loves it and that was the point. If you're thinking about this item, we are very happy with the build quality and the price was good. All the wood is smooth, so no woody about splinters etc. Very happy customer.
